description: This Java class defines configuration properties for an application, including parameters such as maximum instances and startup timeout, with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ApplicationConfigProperties
classes.description: Holds configurable properties related to application startup and deployment, such as max instances and startup timeout.

methods.name: getStartupTimeout
methods.description: Returns the configured startup timeout in seconds.

methods.name: setStartupTimeout
methods.description: Sets the startup timeout; throws exception if value is less than 1.

methods.name: getMaxInstances
methods.description: Calculates and returns the number of verticles to deploy based on configuration and available processors.

methods.name: setMaxInstances
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of verticles to deploy; throws exception if negative.
